content.description: Waiting doesn't make your project any cheaper. Here's what financing with Lyon can do for you.

items.title: Lock In Current Project Pricing
items.text: Moving forward now can help lock in today's prices and avoid potentially higher costs down the road.

items.title: Build the Backyard You Really Want
items.text: Financing can make the patio, pool deck, upgrades and complete outdoor living project more attainable now, not years from now.

items.title: Keep Your Cash Working
items.text: Financing gives you another way to pay while keeping more of your savings and investments intact.

items.title: Get Your Free Estimate
items.text: Tell us about your driveway, patio, pool deck or outdoor living project and we'll put together a detailed quote.

items.title: Apply with Lyon
items.text: Complete Lyon Financial's secure online application. Rates and terms depend on your qualifications and lender requirements.

items.title: Build Now, Pay Later
items.text: Once approved, we schedule your build. Your first payment isn't due until 90 days after funding.

content.title: Financing outdoor living since 1979.
content.text: Lyon Financial has been helping homeowners finance pools, patios, pergolas, landscaping and complete backyard builds for more than four decades — with higher amounts and some of the longest terms available.
content.ownedText: Lyon Financial is an ESOP company — our people, our company.
content.compareText: Looking for a smaller project or a quicker decision? Maxima also works with Hearth.

items.question: What does "no payments for 90 days" mean?
items.answer: Your first payment isn't due until 90 days after your loan is funded. Interest does accrue from the date of funding, including during the 90-day deferral period.

items.question: What projects can I finance with Lyon?
items.answer: Driveways, patios, pool decks, walkways, outdoor living spaces and complete backyard projects — amounts up to $250,000 and terms up to 30 years.

items.question: Is Lyon Financial the lender?
items.answer: No. Lyon Financial is not a lender — it connects you with lending partners. Rates and terms vary based on your qualifications and lender requirements.

items.question: Is Lyon my only financing option?
items.answer: No. Maxima also works with Hearth, a quick option for most concrete work. You can compare both on our financing page and choose the offer that fits your budget.
